text.en: Executive Order No. 67 is hereby revoked.

All laws, orders, issuances, rules, regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with this Executive Order
are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 26th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen
hundred and eighty-six.
